evidence_notes: WSP is the whole method: the LLM writes every parameter of a frozen linear/mlp8 network from an in-context table with no code execution or evaluation before submission (p.1, p.3), so direct_values and open_loop. Each construction is sealed under an author-run SHA-256 digest with a stated expected score (p.3-4), so internal rather than a third-party registry. One sealed pass per rung (p.22); the synthetic rungs were generated by the same model that wrote the constructions (p.23). Sonnet delivered nothing on three rungs and no 4-bit open-weight model (0.49B-8B) delivered even toy_line (p.18-19). On concrete, gradient descent and GBT beat the construction (p.14). The text says materials are 'released' but gives no link. Parameter counts are not stated (mlp8 has 8 hidden units).
